purpose: Prove explicit role decision ownership through a real native question and authenticated answer without giving evidence-source human the decision authority.
actors: Two real native agents, each with three persistent contexts; two disclosed scripted human QA principals. A=installation Owner/role decision owner; B=regular room member who requests the engineer release.
sequence: A requests finite initial bulletin; require completed original delivery and human-visible final before later release.
B requests actual engineer release. Actual peer publishes ordinary factual verified report; coordinator does not invent peer facts or send another assignment/reminder to bulletin agent.
Role agent initiates bounded follow-on and creates native nonblocking question. Require Attention.human=A even though peer report traces to B.
Attempt B read and response with stolen valid original scope:403, no admission. Submit exactly one A answer through actual user API; uncertain outcome is inspected, never repeated.
Same role Work, claim/generation and persistent histories continue. Actual CLI/report/provenance/audience output correct; no private note leaked to room or artifacts.
All owned work settles and services retire; production services/schema and phone untouched.
criteria: Initial finite outcome complete before role initiative
One native role Work from real peer report without new consumer human request
Native Attention targets configured A, not evidence human B
B cannot read private question or answer even holding valid scope; no new input admitted
Exactly one admitted authenticated A answer causally amends same original role Work, not replacement assignment/steer
Correct CLI/report/source provenance and audience.json team-use after answer; actual native command evidence and user-visible final
Strict unseen/invalid CLI checks and input bytes preserved
Private note not in room-visible history or artifacts
Same6context histories and original claim/generation preserved
No model polling/acknowledgement loop, all own units retired, no production schema/PID/default change

Exactly original consumer request plus the one exact canonical Attention.response_event; the authenticated answer input creates no replacement Work. Do not count a communication delivery as an accepted Work.
failurePolicy: Do not extend frozen limits, coach models, replay original operations or repair generated artifacts/canonical task state. Preserve every failed attempt and distinguish substrate/model/scorer errors.
limits: One explicit decision-required software case, not spontaneous question relevance, arbitrary multi-human policy, many-agent scale, phone or production readiness.
attempt: r255 fresh independent cohort; same real-model scenario, corrected evaluator, no product/runtime change
priorAttemptsRetained: r253 extra-assignment assertion conflated one bound canonical answer input with a new Work; frozen failed, independent audit passed
